names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Викторин (Добронравов), иерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, two other Dobronravov folders carrying other forenames.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives for him; no year of birth anywhere, and no reading of his own.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра и Василия, Викторина пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: The third of the three presbyters of the day’s last line, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS FOR HIM: the line carries two readings for three men, and both belong to the other two. No `related` rows join the three, for the reason given on the first man’s row. No folder held him: `fk.mjs` on «Викторин (Добронравов)» returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Добронравов» over every `saint.json` returns two folders, both of other forenames. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, AND THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page carries eight hymn blocks and not one of them is under his name or the line’s.
